observations.trace: MapRoute uses serde try_from a checked wire and its constructor admits2 through65,536 points. The map command viewport deserializer requires positive clipped width and height, full dimensions at least those values, finite nonnegative offsets and at most one pixel outward rounding. MapPointerDisplacement admission rejects nonfinite components. Thus the historical empty route and zero canvas denominators are not established from the inspected admitted protocol.

observations.trace: The installer validates document source and requested city against the presented map, activates its preparation, then either returns an Arc-identical resident product or stages a hidden root and ground/building installation. If that staged installation fails it despawns the new root; the prior pending entry is replaced only on successful Replacement. Current city publication checks assembly failure, published marker and owner GPU readiness, and separately counts settled frames. The exact old/current city body diff changes only the waiting_pipelines module path.

observations.trace: obstacle_seed converts checked scene point float bits to named stream inputs; stable_text_seed converts text to bytes at a named seed derivation boundary. recipe_mesh converts LodMesh vertices and indices to a native Mesh and expects successful tangent generation for selected materials. Regional lighting copies matching celestial light and transform to a map layer, suppresses sunlight below its native horizon and disables map shadows.

conditional_findings.canonical_owner: The admitted map pose and its geographic window selection, with explicit partial-coverage meaning shared by status and native presentation.
conditional_findings.first_failed_contract: For an admitted view, the largest single selected terrain window can be narrower than the view footprint used by the request calculation; status must not imply full viewport coverage unless that policy is actually established.
conditional_findings.trace: PositiveLength admits finite positive8,192,000m and MapSpan admits it as its inclusive maximum. A1000 by500 physical CanvasRect with zero offsets passes the inspected map viewport admission. At yaw zero, requested_window computes aspect2, width16,384,000m and needed as twice the larger projected width/height, hence at least32,768,000m. Every offered scale supplies65 vertices, or64 intervals; Continent is the largest at128,000m spacing, giving8,192,000m per side. No candidate satisfies needed, so the source chooses Continent by fallback. Its regional mesh positions span at most that width, half the source-computed horizontal footprint, even before the extra coverage margin. The normal strategic producer starts at60,000m; browser source maps zoom-out to ratio1.25 and the typed zoom clamps to the admitted maximum, but no interaction was executed.
conditional_findings.status_trace: Map status sets covered from matching source plus SurfaceCoverage::Drawn; present creates Drawn when regional_mesh returns Some, and the mesh returns Some for at least one complete triangle, not for complete viewport coverage. Browser source uses !state.covered to choose the terrain-unavailable message. This establishes the source meaning of the flag, not a claim that it promises full coverage or that a user saw misleading UI.
conditional_findings.safeguards: This is source arithmetic for an admitted type-level example, not a generated request, loaded terrain pack, actual camera, displayed pixels, browser event or product test. Actual geographic package availability and supported UI viewport dimensions, user intent, multi-window or partial-coverage policy, rendering and all aliases remain unproved. Missing source samples are intentionally explicit holes; do not fabricate terrain to conceal them. A full-width 2:1 view was chosen; cropped views can expose a different portion.
